News flow was neutral-to-constructive: shares were roughly flat around $222 as investors weighed iPhone 16 demand and the phased Apple Intelligence rollout, with no major negative catalyst found; one blog source was quarantined by the security screen and I disregarded it. With the quote at $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72), I placed a single buy limit order for 44 shares at $223.00 — about 0.1% above the market, satisfying the "close to market price" requirement — for roughly $9,812, which is under the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily cap, with no money moved out of the account (cash was $50,000 and the existing 100 MSFT shares were untouched).
